goal: Make one user decision require at most one confirmation across Brainstorm, Planner, Enrollment, breaking intent revision, stale-claim repair, and Review authorization. Preserve native host UI as the only digest-bound authority gate. Treat direct requirements, answered questions, and bulk-approved recommendations as confirmed decisions; use an unchanged final summary only as a correction window; require explicit confirmation only for a newly introduced or changed material decision. For clear mutation requests, proceed from a validated TaskIntent directly to native Enrollment without chat pre-confirmation. For Plan-only requests, treat a later start Enrollment reply as a non-authoritative execution trigger. After awaiting_user, a complete breaking revision, or a proven stale claim, invoke the corresponding native authorization Tool directly. Keep all Kernel capabilities, snapshot revalidation, rehearsal, cancellation, zero-write, Review decision, and persisted-schema behavior unchanged; add no chat authority parser, token, compatibility layer, or runtime state.

acceptance.assertion: Brainstorm and Planner contracts treat direct requirements, answered questions, and bulk approval as confirmation of those decisions; an unchanged result-only summary is a non-blocking correction window; only a newly introduced or changed material decision requires confirmation before handoff; and agent judgment alone still cannot hand off unconfirmed proposed direction or scope.

Planner contracts route a clear mutation request from validated TaskIntent directly to the native digest-bound Enrollment gate without chat pre-confirmation, while an explicit Plan-only request stops and a later start Enrollment reply is described as a non-authoritative execution trigger rather than approval.

Loop and Work Tool contracts direct the Parent to invoke request_authorization, approve_breaking_intent_revision, and repair_authority_state without asking for a chat pre-confirmation, leaving each existing native interaction as the only authority decision.
